kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: 1 year in, National Guard became a part of D.C. life. And, deadly quake hits Colombia
wire.summary: Today marks one year since the National Guard was deployed to the nation's capital. Here's what has happened since. And, a 7.4 magnitude earthquake leaves more than 100 people dead in Colombia.

wire.title: The secret economics inside the new Planet Money board game
wire.summary: From Nobel Prize-winning research to the Laffer Curve, Scabby the Rat, Veblen's peacock, and more — the economic ideas and inside jokes hiding throughout Planet Money's new board game.

wire.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia
wire.summary: A Syrian court sentenced Assad along with his brother to death in absentia for crimes against humanity and war crimes during Syria's 14-year conflict that left about half a million people dead.

wire.title: A midwife crosses 'maternity deserts' to make a difference for Black moms and babies
wire.summary: New research from the March of Dimes says more than half of U.S. counties have no labor and delivery hospitals. One Black midwife tries to make a difference for moms in Alabama.

wire.title: Alabama holds second primary Tuesday, leading to confusion, concerns about low turnout
wire.summary: After Alabama redrew its congressional maps in May, voters in several districts saw their primaries pushed to August. Now, it's time to vote and there are concerns confusion will dampen voter turnout.

wire.title: The school year begins in LA with one big change: limited screen time
wire.summary: As educators in the nation's second-largest district prepare for the new limits on classroom screen time, some teachers say it will be a difficult adjustment.

wire.title: In Minnesota and Wisconsin, competitive primaries will again test power of progressive candidates
wire.summary: A week after the Michigan primary, tests of progressive power will play out in the Midwest, raising questions of whether far left candidates can win come November or if the GOP can pick up moderates.

wire.title: Armed troops have patrolled D.C. for 1 year now. It's challenging democratic norms
wire.summary: The deployment is expected to cost in the billions after it was quietly extended until Inauguration Day of 2029.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Voters in six states head to the polls Tuesday for high-profile primaries, Trump signals his strategy with Iran is shifting, 7.4 magnitude earthquake kills at least 111 people in Colombia.

wire.title: Turkey's parliament approves a pardon-like bill for thousands of PKK militants
wire.summary: Turkey's parliament approved legislation that would introduce a conditional pardon for thousands of Kurdish militants in a bid to advance the government's peace initiative with their insurgent group.

wire.title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
wire.summary: The US president was reportedly part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

wire.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
wire.summary: Ukraine's president says strikes in Zaporizhzhia - which killed at least six and injured 19 - involved ballistic missiles from Russia's ally.

wire.title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
wire.summary: The ex-president is convicted of committing war crimes and crimes against humanity during the country's civil war.

wire.title: At least 169 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
wire.summary: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

wire.title: Libyan authorities battle big blaze at major oil refinery
wire.summary: Monday's drone strike on the Zawiya refinery was the third such incident in two days.

wire.title: Australia PM under fire for remarks on Japanese counterpart's melon gifts
wire.summary: An ex-Japanese envoy said the "sexist" comments "betrayed the close bond" between the countries.
